_about: Translation preset per video, handed to the console in the beacon (sourceLanguage, detectableLanguages, translationModel).
Keys are video names (file name without extension, matched like description.txt). A video without a preset gets none: the console uses its own .env task.
source: one language code, or auto (then detectable lists what to detect among, most frequent first).
model: delta2 only for a source Delta2 serves (en de es fr it nl pt ru), with a fixed source; auto for everything else.
Sources and detectable lists come from the transcripts of the 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-12 runs (segments per detected language).
